# testing_import_multiple_id (Resource)

ImportMultipleID Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_import_multiple_id" "my_importmultipleid" {
  param1                = "...my_param1..."
  param2                = "...my_param2..."
  request_body_property = "...my_request_body_property..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `param1` (String)
- `param2` (String)

### Optional

- `request_body_property` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_import_multiple_id.my_testing_import_multiple_id
  id = jsonencode({
    param1 = "..."
    param2 = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_import_multiple_id.my_testing_import_multiple_id '{"param1": "...", "param2": "..."}'
```
